items.title: Eddie Miller and Pete Fountain Interview, 1970-01-09
items.q: Well, the trombone player that's working with me now, Jack Delaney,

ctx.x: I want to ask Mr. Pete a question. Mr. Pete, how long has Leon Kellner been playing in the Roosevelt Hotel? How long has that man been playing music over there? I've been unable to get an answer. I asked several people and say they don't know.
Well, the trombone player that's working with me now, Jack Delaney, worked with him for, oh, I'd say almost 10 years. And I'd say he's been here at least 25 years.
At least that long, because I remember hearing that man on the radio playing music at least 25 years ago.
